pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3 @ 3.2 GHZ
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX9
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 256 GB available space

short_description: Here’s a chill casual collection sim game! In another dimensional world, you’ll use an old book to keep collecting all sorts of cute, weird, funny creatures in different styles. Your aim? Track down the oldest one and become the ultimate collection master! And yeah, this game will keep updating！
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean
